daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo attended the anniversary celebration of the Democratic Party, where he praised the party and reflected on his political journey. Prabowo told attendees he had requested the people's mandate four times before finally receiving it. He also praised the Democratic Party for not being destructive when it was out of power. AHY's political speech at the event drew varied interpretations, with analysts reading it as signaling dissatisfaction or even a presidential bid for 2029.

  • AHY stated that political competition is fierce with everyone wanting to win and take a role.
  • AHY affirmed that the Democratic Party will oversee government policies, a statement welcomed by Prabowo.
  • PDI-P commented on AHY's prospects for the 2029 presidential election, noting he would need to work hard to catch up with KDM and Prabowo.
  • Political parties are recruiting influencers as a strategy to expand their voter base.
  • Village Minister Yandri assured that the Village Association will oversee President Prabowo's Asta Cita program.
  • The Hajj Ministry instructed all officials to be cooperative and transparent during the BPK audit.
  • Kompas published an editorial titled "Rakus Kuasa" (Power Hungry) commenting on political dynamics.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesia and Sudan explored cooperation in food security during defence talks. The two countries discussed food security as part of their bilateral defence dialogue. Sudan's Defence Minister made a strong statement of support, with the Sudanese official declaring that those hostile to Indonesia are enemies of Sudan.

  • Japan is preparing ships and helicopters to assist Indonesia in handling forest fires, with wildlife protection a priority.

Other

The government is preparing a mass bank account program with an Rp 11 trillion budget, warning against misuse. Indonesia is allocating Rp 11 trillion for the mass banking initiative. The government warned that anyone using the accounts for online gambling will be immediately arrested. The program aims to improve financial inclusion across Indonesia.

  • Oil prices surged past US$101 per barrel.
  • Indonesia streamlined foreign worker permits to a five-day processing period.
  • The death toll from the NTT earthquake rose to 136 people.
  • Airlangga stated that zakat and waqf funds remain scattered, with potential reaching Rp 343 trillion.
  • A legal expert stated that the MBG food poisoning incident due to negligence fulfills criminal elements.
